name: UTIL: Ultra-wideband Time-difference-of-arrival Indoor Localization Dataset
description: Public UWB TDOA positioning dataset featuring LOS and NLOS identification experiments, including UWB signal measurements under obstacles, as well as real-world quadrotor flight data in cluttered environments.
citation: Wenda Zhao, Abhishek Goudar, Xinyuan Qiao, and Angela P. Schoellig. UTIL: An Ultra-wideband Time-difference-of-arrival Indoor Localization Dataset. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 43(10):1443–1456, 2024. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2203.14471

license.notes: Dataset license not published on the project dataset page; unverified.
